title: Pictogram Catalogue — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Catalogue sheet A
scenes.purpose: Show one recognisable bulb pictogram carried across three front-facing cards while the wider symbol grows into a connected system.
visuals: Deep blue sheet with title and footer caption
Three light cards on one baseline with chevrons
Shared bulb component drawn from one SVG definition
Coral accent marks the new parts on each card

beats.development: Card 01: the bulb resolves as a complete form and its label appears; brief hold.
The same bulb travels along the baseline into card 02 and shrinks; two coral links draw out of it and their nodes appear once the shafts arrive; label 02 appears and holds.
The bulb is carried again into card 03 and shrinks further; a coral ring closes around it, six spokes extend and six nodes join; label 03 appears and the full catalogue holds settled from 2.5 s.

findings: Each symbol completes before the bulb is carried forward; carries take 0.4 s each.
Title and footer caption stay visible throughout.
justifiedHolds: Final 0.5 s hold lets the complete three-card sheet read as a whole.

notes: No reviewed preview recipes were supplied in STYLE.json; the preview demonstrates the core characteristic action.
Card 01 and 02 keep their own settled bulb so the sheet reads as a catalogue.
